name: Manhattan Goes Wild

features.name: Bugsy / Betty Goes Wild
features.description: A character turns wild for a spin.

features.name: Wild Party Respins
features.description: Both characters lock as wild stacks.

review:
A light, stylish 5x3 gangster game with Bugsy and Betty. Either can randomly go wild for a spin, and landing both full-height triggers Wild Party Respins with their stacks locked as wilds.

Three scatters start the night-time Manhattan Freespins, where collecting premium symbols turns them wild. Medium volatility, a 2,025x cap. A nice entry-level game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
